brief:
Hundreds of thousands of Israeli settlers raided the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in recent days during a Jewish holiday, Al Jazeera reported, citing the Jerusalem Governorate. The incursions mark a significant spike in visits to the sensitive site.

The Al-Aqsa Mosque in occupied East Jerusalem is one of Islam's holiest sites. Settler visits to the compound have repeatedly triggered Palestinian protests and Israeli-Palestinian clashes.
dek: Al-Aqsa Mosque sees mass settler raids during Jewish holiday Thousands of Israeli settlers have conducted mass raids of the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in recent days, Al Jazeera is reporting, citing the Jerusalem Governorate.
title: Hundreds of thousands of settlers raid Al-Aqsa Mosque
